vertices.purpose: Writes status.json with keys sorted, creating the directory if needed, by writing a per-process temp file and renaming it over the target.
inputs: dir: tasks directory; created if missing
statusMap: map from task filename to its status entry
outputs: none (void)
vertices.sig_seen: function writeStatusMap(dir: string, statusMap: StatusMap): void

vertices.purpose: Returns the epic directory under the main checkout for a slug, or null when the slug is not a valid epic slug.
inputs: projectRoot: project root path (resolved to the main checkout)
slug: epic slug
outputs: <main checkout>/<EPICS_DIR>/<slug> path, or null for an invalid slug
vertices.sig_seen: function epicDirFor(projectRoot: string, slug: string): string | null

vertices.purpose: Reads and parses a claim file, accepting it only if it has string session_id and claimed_at fields.
inputs: filePath: path to a claim JSON file
outputs: the ClaimFile, or null if the file is unreadable, unparsable, or missing a required field
vertices.sig_seen: function readClaimFile(filePath: string): ClaimFile | null

vertices.purpose: Builds a fresh StatusMap for the given task files: done if the file is in doneSet, ready if every blockedBy entry is done or not present among the files, otherwise blocked; keeps any epic link from the previous map.
inputs: dir: tasks directory the task files are read from
files: task filenames to include
doneSet: set of filenames already done
previous: earlier StatusMap whose epic links are carried over (default {})
outputs: StatusMap keyed by filename, each entry with status, blockedBy, and an epic field when one was previously linked
vertices.sig_seen: function buildStatusMap(dir: string, files: string[], doneSet: Set<string>, previous: StatusMap = {}): StatusMap

vertices.purpose: Returns the path of the JSON claim file for a given task filename.
inputs: tasksDir: path to the task queue directory
filename: task file name; only its basename is used
outputs: <claims dir>/<basename>.json path
vertices.sig_seen: function claimPathFor(tasksDir: string, filename: string): string

vertices.purpose: Turns a list of task filenames into MaestroTask records, deriving each task's status from status.json, the done set and blockedBy, and attaching any claim.
inputs: dir: tasks directory path
files: task filenames in that directory
statusMap: parsed status.json entries keyed by filename
claims: per-filename claim records, empty by default
outputs: MaestroTask[] with filename, relativePath, title, blockedBy, status (ready, blocked, done or the materialized value), content, claim and optional epic
vertices.sig_seen: function tasksFromFiles(dir: string, files: string[], statusMap: StatusMap, claims: Map<string, TaskClaim> = new Map()): MaestroTask[]

vertices.purpose: Removes a task's claim file, but only when the calling session is the one that owns it.
inputs: tasksDir: path to the task queue directory
filename: task file name to release
sessionId: id of the session asking to release
outputs: ReleaseResult: 'released', 'no-claim', or 'not-owner'
vertices.sig_seen: function releaseTask(tasksDir: string, filename: string, sessionId: string): ReleaseResult

vertices.purpose: Returns the claims directory path under a tasks directory.
inputs: tasksDir: path to the task queue directory
outputs: path.join(tasksDir, CLAIMS_DIR_NAME)
vertices.sig_seen: function claimsDirFor(tasksDir: string): string

vertices.purpose: Reads status.json from a tasks directory and returns it as a StatusMap, or an empty map if the file is missing, unparseable, or not an object.
inputs: dir: tasks directory that contains status.json
outputs: StatusMap parsed from status.json, or {}
vertices.sig_seen: function readStatusMap(dir: string): StatusMap

vertices.purpose: Sets or clears the epic field on the status.json entries for the named task files, writing nothing if any name is unknown.
inputs: projectRoot: project path
filenames: task filenames to update; basenames are used
epic: epic slug to set, or null to clear the field
outputs: SetEpicResult with changed (names written) and missing (unknown names); changed is empty when any name is missing
vertices.sig_seen: function setTaskEpic(projectRoot: string, filenames: string[], epic: string | null): SetEpicResult

vertices.purpose: Lists the .md files in a tasks directory, sorted with localeCompare so numbered files come out in their run order.
inputs: dir: tasks directory
outputs: sorted array of .md filenames; empty array if the directory cannot be read
vertices.sig_seen: function listTaskFiles(dir: string): string[]

vertices.purpose: Reports whether a claiming session still counts as live, based on how recently its session log was modified.
inputs: claudeDir: the .claude directory path
sessionId: id of the session holding the claim
now: current time in epoch ms (defaults to Date.now())
outputs: true when the session directory exists and its log mtime is within CLAIM_IDLE_CAP_MS of now, otherwise false
vertices.sig_seen: function isSessionLive(claudeDir: string, sessionId: string, now: number = Date.now()): boolean

vertices.purpose: Projects the status.json map into a per-file tracker record of status, epic and blockedBy, normalising blockedBy to an array.
inputs: projectRoot: project path
outputs: Record keyed by filename of {status, epic, blockedBy}; blockedBy is [] when not an array
vertices.sig_seen: function readTaskTracker(projectRoot: string): Record<string, TrackerEntry>

vertices.purpose: Runs a mutation on an epic's state.json under the epic directory lock: it throws if the epic or its state file is missing, applies fn to the current state, then writes the state back.
inputs: projectRoot: project root that holds the epic directory
slug: epic slug
fn: mutator that receives the current EpicState and returns a value
outputs: the value returned by fn
vertices.sig_seen: function updateState(projectRoot: string, slug: string, fn: (state: EpicState) => T): T

vertices.purpose: Polls the task queue on an interval and calls back with the initial snapshot and with each later snapshot whose serialized form differs from the last one.
inputs: projectRoot: project path
events: optional init and update callbacks
intervalMs: poll interval in milliseconds, default 1000
outputs: A stop function that clears the timer and prevents further callbacks
vertices.sig_seen: function tailTasks(projectRoot: string, events: Partial<TaskQueueTailEvents>, intervalMs = 1000): () => void

vertices.purpose: Lists the claim files in the claims directory, returns the live ones keyed by task filename, and deletes the claim files whose sessions are not live.
inputs: projectRoot: project root path
tasksDir: path to the task queue directory
now: current time in epoch ms (defaults to Date.now())
outputs: Map from task filename to TaskClaim (sessionId, claimedAt, live, optional sessionName) for claims read from the directory
vertices.sig_seen: function readClaims(projectRoot: string, tasksDir: string, now: number = Date.now()): Map<string, TaskClaim>

vertices.purpose: Extracts the optional session name from a claim as a sessionName field.
inputs: claim: parsed ClaimFile
outputs: { sessionName } when session_name is a non-empty string, otherwise {}
vertices.sig_seen: function nameOf(claim: ClaimFile): { sessionName?: string; }

vertices.purpose: Reads a file from a directory as UTF-8, returning an empty string instead of throwing when the read fails.
inputs: dir: directory containing the file
filename: file name within that directory
outputs: file contents as a string, or '' on any read error
vertices.sig_seen: function readFileSafe(dir: string, filename: string): string

vertices.purpose: Returns the task queue directory under the main checkout root, so a call made from inside a git worktree still resolves to the main checkout's queue.
inputs: projectRoot: project path, which may be inside a git worktree
outputs: path to the TASKS_SUBDIR directory inside the main checkout root
vertices.sig_seen: function tasksDirFor(projectRoot: string): string

vertices.purpose: Claims a task file for a session, replacing a claim whose session is no longer live and reporting already-claimed when another live session holds it.
inputs: projectRoot: project root path
tasksDir: path to the task queue directory
filename: task file name to claim
sessionId: id of the claiming session
now: current time in epoch ms (defaults to Date.now())
sessionName: optional display name for the session
outputs: ClaimResult: outcome 'claimed', or 'already-claimed' with the holding claim
vertices.sig_seen: function claimTask(projectRoot: string, tasksDir: string, filename: string, sessionId: string, now: number = Date.now(), sessionName?: string | null): ClaimResult

vertices.purpose: Returns the current time as an ISO 8601 string.
outputs: new Date().toISOString() value
vertices.sig_seen: function now(): string

vertices.purpose: Formats an ISO timestamp as a coarse relative age for display in the tasks view.
inputs: iso: ISO timestamp string
outputs: 'just now' under a minute, then '<n>m ago', '<n>h ago' or '<n>d ago'; 'unknown' when the timestamp does not parse
vertices.sig_seen: function ago(iso: string): string

vertices.purpose: Returns the '## Post-Mortem' section of a task file, from its heading up to the next level-2 heading, trimmed.
inputs: content: full markdown text of a task file
outputs: trimmed section text including its heading, or null if the section is absent
vertices.sig_seen: function extractPostMortemSection(content: string): string | null

vertices.purpose: Lists the task queue for a project by resolving the main checkout, then reading the task files, status.json and claims and building the task records.
inputs: projectRoot: project path, possibly a worktree; resolved to the main checkout
outputs: MaestroTask[] for the project's queue, or [] when projectRoot is empty
vertices.sig_seen: function listTasks(projectRoot: string): MaestroTask[]

vertices.purpose: Reads an epic's state.json and returns it normalised as an EpicState, or null if the epic directory is missing or the file is unreadable or not an object.
inputs: projectRoot: project root that holds the epic directory
slug: epic slug, resolved to a directory by epicDirFor
outputs: EpicState with slug, created_at (string or empty), manager (object with a name, or null), workers and log (arrays, or empty); null on any failure
vertices.sig_seen: function readEpicState(projectRoot: string, slug: string): EpicState | null

vertices.purpose: Deletes a task file, appends its Post-Mortem section to postmortems.log when present, removes its claim, rebuilds the status map for the remaining files, and returns the refreshed queue.
inputs: projectRoot: project path, resolved to the main checkout
filename: task file to delete; basename is used
outputs: MaestroTask[] for the remaining files; the unchanged queue when the filename is not a known task file, or [] when projectRoot is empty
vertices.sig_seen: function deleteTask(projectRoot: string, filename: string): MaestroTask[]

vertices.purpose: Extracts the task filenames listed under the '## Blocked by' heading of a task file, de-duplicated and in first-seen order.
inputs: content: full markdown text of a task file
outputs: array of unique NNN-*.md filenames found in backticks in that section; empty array if there is no such section
vertices.sig_seen: function parseBlockedBy(content: string): string[]

vertices.purpose: Marks one task file done in status.json, rebuilds the status map so tasks it unblocks become ready, drops its claim, and returns the refreshed queue.
inputs: projectRoot: project path, resolved to the main checkout
filename: task file to close; basename is used
outputs: MaestroTask[] after the close; the unchanged queue when the filename is not a known task file, or [] when projectRoot is empty
vertices.sig_seen: function closeTask(projectRoot: string, filename: string): MaestroTask[]
